arguments.message: 建立台北 101 基座、入口與低層帷幕

plan.method: Editable projected polygons and surface grids in metres at 100 px/m; fixed orthographic elevated three-quarter view, azimuth 35°, elevation 25°. Verified 508 m total height; module widths, local elevations, podium and ornaments are explicit reference-informed estimates, not surveyed construction drawings. Transparent surroundings.

whole.requirement: Entire Taipei 101 from base to spire, distinctive silhouette, no schematic simplification.
whole.description: Complete recognizable detailed tower with eight projecting modules, tapering base and crown/spire; no added surrounding scene.

view.requirement: Fixed elevated three-quarter view looking down, visible top surfaces and consistent perspective.
view.description: Shared projection throughout façades, ledges, roof surfaces and ornaments.

detail.requirement: Highly detailed realistic editable illustration including façade, window frames and visible ornamentation.
detail.description: Inspect base/entry, bamboo tiers and corner ornament, crown/roof/spire at sufficient scale.

light.description: Blue-green reflective glazing, metallic highlights, coherent lighter and darker faces and recess/contact shadows.

native-scale.requirement: Editable 2D shapes at real-world 1 cm=1px before perspective.
native-scale.description: Native vectors, repeated individual pane/frame geometry, 100 px/m shared projection, 508 m tip; local reference estimates documented.

brief.intent: Entire tower base including entrance, lower tapered shaft and visible podium surfaces.
brief.viewpoint: Orthographic azimuth35 elevation25; world metres; scale100.
sources: CTBUH 508m; Evergreen upper/lower framing plans; architect eight-storey module description
assumptions: Base width63.5m and upper-base46.5m adopted as reference-informed estimates.
Base-to-first-module117m, podium38m and all local mullion/ornament dimensions are illustration estimates.

arguments.message: 建立八節竹節塔身、雙階轉角及逐片窗框

brief.intent: Eight fully detailed flaring tower modules with glazing, stepped corners, cornices, top ledges, mechanical louvers and ruyi ornament.
brief.viewpoint: Shared azimuth35 elevation25 scale100 projection; metres.
sources: Architect Oneness eight-storey modules; Evergreen upper floor double-step corner plan
assumptions: Eight modules117–385.8m, each33.6m tall; widths45.5–51.5m and local ornament profiles are reference-informed illustration estimates.
